content: Due to the high variety of events discussed online and the difficulty in obtaining annotated data for training, traditional template-based or supervised learning approaches for event extraction are no longer applicable in dealing with online texts. Nevertheless, newsworthy events are often discussed by many tweets or online news articles. Therefore, the same event could be mentioned by a high volume of redundant tweets or news articles. This property inspires the research community to devise clustering-based models BIBREF0 , BIBREF1 , BIBREF2 to discover new or previously unidentified events without extracting structured representations.
